page_title: PAU 0-4 MON | St. Pauli v B. Monchengladbach 01/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's it for today, Robert Hartmann has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+4' A yellow card is awarded to Andreas Hountondji (St. Pauli).
90+4' Connor Metcalfe (St. Pauli) hits a shot towards the bottom left corner from the edge of the box, but it's a weak attempt and is easily saved by Moritz Nicolas.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
85' Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Rocco Reitz.
84' Eugen Polanski prepares a substitution. Haris Tabakovic is replaced by Jan Urbich (B. Monchengladbach).
84' Substitution. Manolis Saliakas did his best and is replaced by Jackson Irvine (St. Pauli).
82' Eric Smith (St. Pauli) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.

80' 0 - 4 Shuto Machino has a shot blocked by the goalkeeper, but the ball rebounds off his hands and Oscar Fraulo (B. Monchengladbach) is quickest to latch on to it. He fires the ball in off the left post. The score is now 0:4.
80' Shuto Machino (B. Monchengladbach) takes the ball, nicely zig-zags through the defence, but his shot to the right post is smartly dealt with by Nikola Vasilj.
78' Eugen Polanski has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Giovanni Reyna (B. Monchengladbach) replacing Florian Neuhaus.
78' Here comes a substitution. Joe Scally is given a rest as he is replaced by Oscar Fraulo (B. Monchengladbach).

75' 0 - 3 Goal! Great play by Haris Tabakovic releases Shuto Machino (B. Monchengladbach) in space on the edge of the box. He spots the keeper off his line and coolly puts the ball into the right side of the goal. 0:3.
73' None of the B. Monchengladbach players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.

73' Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the bottom right corner is blocked by Nikola Vasilj, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net. B. Monchengladbach get a corner.
72' The resulting set piece from St. Pauli is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
72' Manolis Saliakas (St. Pauli) wins the ball after the corner kick and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
71' The linesman makes the right call and St. Pauli will have a corner.
71' Eric Smith (St. Pauli) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going in the bottom right corner, but Moritz Nicolas has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.
70' The attendance is 29546.
70' A snap shot by Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom right corner, but Nikola Vasilj produces a good save to thwart him.
68' The referee blows his whistle for a foul after Abdoulie Ceesay (St. Pauli) overruns the ball during an attack and makes an aggressive challenge on his opponent.
66' Connor Metcalfe (St. Pauli) takes a mid-range shot, but the ball sails high over the bar.
63' Robert Hartmann shows a yellow card to Abdoulie Ceesay (St. Pauli) for a tough tackle.
62' Haris Tabakovic (B. Monchengladbach) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and floats well wide of the right post.
60' Robert Hartmann shows a yellow card to Manolis Saliakas (St. Pauli), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
57' Eugen Polanski decides to make a substitution. Franck Honorat will be replaced by Shuto Machino (B. Monchengladbach).

57' Haris Tabakovic (B. Monchengladbach) creates himself some space inside the goalmouth and connects with the free kick. His accurate header would have probably ended up inside the right post, but Nikola Vasilj pulls off a superb reflex save to thwart him.
55' St. Pauli fail to score from a corner as Moritz Nicolas (B. Monchengladbach) leaps to collect the ball.
55' The game has come to an end for James Sands. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Connor Metcalfe (St. Pauli).
54' Andreas Hountondji (St. Pauli) latches onto a pass under pressure from an opponent, but still gets his shot away. It’s a fine effort, but goes just over the bar.
46' Half-time substitution. Alexander Blessin decided to make a change. Mathias Pereira Lage is replaced by Andreas Hountondji (St. Pauli).
46' Half-time substitution. Danel Sinani is replaced by Abdoulie Ceesay (St. Pauli).
46' Alexander Blessin has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Martijn Kaars (St. Pauli) comes on the pitch for Oladapo Afolayan.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' St. Pauli are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
45' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Danel Sinani (St. Pauli) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
43' St. Pauli have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
40' 0 - 2 Haris Tabakovic (B. Monchengladbach) collects a sweet pass and fires a low shot into the bottom right corner, leaving the keeper helpless.
34' Neat passing move from St. Pauli in order to create new attacking opportunities.
30' Haris Tabakovic (B. Monchengladbach) controls a pass, goes past a defender and curls a shot from the edge of the box right onto the left post.
27' Danel Sinani (St. Pauli) has an effort on goal, but he misses to the right of the goal.
26' The corner is swung in but St. Pauli can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

26' Manolis Saliakas (St. Pauli) latches on to a low pass and without any hesitation whatsoever releases a first-time rocket towards the bottom left corner. Unfortunately for him, his long-distance effort is blocked by Moritz Nicolas who makes a glorious save! Now St. Pauli have a corner.
25' St. Pauli can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
18' James Sands (St. Pauli) attempts to discuss the decision with Robert Hartmann, but he soon realises that it's not the right thing to do as he sees the yellow.

18' 0 - 1 Here comes the VAR decision. The goal is given and B. Monchengladbach players have a reason to celebrate! Haris Tabakovic (B. Monchengladbach) collects a killer pass and fires a low shot into the middle of the net, giving the goalkeeper no chance.
16' The B. Monchengladbach players joy may have been justified, because referee Robert Hartmann is going use VAR to determine whether it was offside.
15' Haris Tabakovic (B. Monchengladbach) has a goal ruled out for offside!
9' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Oladapo Afolayan (St. Pauli), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
9' Louis Oppie (St. Pauli) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
6' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) decided to shoot after receiving a sweet pass. The ball went low to the middle of the goal, but Nikola Vasilj made a easy save.
1' The match has just started.
St. Pauli will kick the game off.
Robert Hartmann got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
